name: Button
statusNote: Button.docs.json says alpha, a label it has carried since before Button was Primer's most used control; primer.style lists it without a status badge and GitHub ships it everywhere. Treated as stable.
summary: A labelled action. Choose emphasis by variant (primary for the one main action on a surface, default for the rest, danger for destructive actions, invisible for low-emphasis actions in dense UI, link for an action that reads as text), size by the density around it. A button with an href is a LinkButton: the same look, navigating instead of acting.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: The button's text (children). A button with no text is an IconButton; see icon-button.

inputs.name: leadingVisual
inputs.description: A 16px octicon (or any small visual) before the label.

inputs.name: trailingVisual
inputs.description: A visual after the label, inside the content box.

inputs.name: trailingAction
inputs.description: A visual at the button's far end, outside the content box, conventionally a triangle-down for a menu button.

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: A CounterLabel after the label, in the variant's buttonCounter colours. Ignored when trailingVisual is set.

inputs.name: alignContent
inputs.description: Where the label and visuals sit when the button is wider than its content (block buttons).

inputs.name: labelWrap
inputs.description: Let the label wrap; the height becomes a minimum.

inputs.name: loading
inputs.description: Show a small Spinner in place of a visual (or the label) and ignore clicks while keeping focus.

inputs.name: loadingAnnouncement
inputs.description: What assistive technology is told while loading.

inputs.name: inactive
inputs.description: Looks disabled but stays focusable and clickable, for an action that is unavailable for a reason the click explains.

inputs.name: keybindingHint
inputs.description: A KeybindingHint chord shown at the trailing end (rendered by the caller as a [data-kbd-chord] element); the module styles it per variant.

inputs.name: href
inputs.description: Navigate instead of act: the LinkButton form, same visuals, link semantics.

inputs.name: onClick
inputs.description: Activation by pointer, Enter or Space.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: The bordered, rounded box: height by size, 1px border inside it, medium radius, the variant's background and resting shadow.

anatomy.name: Content
anatomy.description: A three-column row (leading visual, label, trailing visual) centred or start-aligned in the container; columns are separated by the size's gap.

anatomy.name: Leading visual
anatomy.description: A 16px icon in the variant's icon colour (fgColor-muted for default).

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: Body text at the size's font size, medium weight, one line by default.

anatomy.name: Trailing visual
anatomy.description: An icon or the count's CounterLabel.

anatomy.name: Trailing action
anatomy.description: An icon at the far end, pulled 4px into the end padding.

anatomy.name: Counter
anatomy.description: A CounterLabel pill in the variant's --buttonCounter-* background.

anatomy.name: Keybinding hint
anatomy.description: A KeybindingHint chord in the variant's --buttonKeybindingHint-* colours; its presence shrinks the end padding to 6px (8px at large).

anatomy.name: Loading spinner
anatomy.description: A 16px Spinner that replaces the leading visual, else the trailing visual or counter, else the trailing action, else sits over the hidden label.

anatomy.name: Notification indicator
anatomy.description: An 8px --fgColor-accent dot with a 2px --bgColor-inset ring at the button's top-right corner (2px outside it) or the leading visual's (4px outside it).

variants.description: Neutral fill with a border and a 1px bottom shadow.
Green (blue in colorblind themes) fill, onEmphasis text, resting-small shadow; the one main action.
Default-looking at rest with danger-coloured text and icon; fills red on hover and press.
No fill, border or shadow at rest; a fill appears on hover.
Text only, in --fgColor-link, no box: no height, padding, border or radius; underlined on hover.
28px tall, 8px side padding, 4px gap, small body text.
32px tall, 12px side padding, 8px gap, medium body text.
40px tall, 16px side padding, 8px gap, medium body text.

layout.text: Height is the size's control size exactly (border included); width hugs the content (min-width: max-content) unless block, which fills the container.

Side padding is --control-medium-paddingInline-normal (12px) at medium, --control-small-paddingInline-condensed (8px) at small, --control-large-paddingInline-spacious (16px) at large; there is no vertical padding, the content is centred in the height.

Leading visual, label and trailing visual are separated by 8px at medium (--base-size-8), the size's gap otherwise; the trailing action follows the content box at the same gap and is pulled 4px into the end padding.

The label is one line (white-space: nowrap) at the body line height; with labelWrap it wraps by word, the height becomes a minimum and the content gains block padding of the size's paddingBlock less 2px.
With a keybinding hint present the end padding shrinks to 6px (8px at large).
A button whose only content is a leading visual and a count pads 8px at medium, 4px at small and 12px at large.
The link variant has no box: no height, padding, border or radius, its font size is the surrounding text's, and its text starts at the left.

states.text: The variant's -rest tokens; default and danger carry --button-default-shadow-resting, primary --shadow-resting-small, invisible none.

Background and border move to the variant's -hover tokens; danger also turns its text, icon, counter and shadow (--shadow-resting-small). Invisible shows a fill and its hover icon colour. Link underlines its label.
The variant's -active tokens, applied with no transition; primary and danger swap their shadow for --button-*-shadow-selected.
While the button controls an open menu (aria-expanded), it keeps its -active background (and, for default, its active border; for primary and danger, the selected shadow).
Keyboard focus only: a 2px --focus-outline-color outline inset 2px, no shadow. Primary adds an inset 3px --fgColor-onEmphasis ring inside the outline. Link offsets the outline 2px outside.
The variant's -disabled tokens (default reads --control-fgColor-disabled for text), no shadow, visuals and counter inherit the text colour; not focusable, ignores input.

A small Spinner replaces the first of leading visual, trailing visual or count, trailing action; with none, it takes the label's place and the label is hidden but keeps its width. The button is aria-disabled, ignores clicks, but stays focusable and keeps its enabled colours.

states.label: inactive
states.text: Inactive looks disabled in --button-inactive-bgColor and --button-inactive-fgColor with no hover or press change, but stays focusable and clickable.

behaviour.text: Activate on pointer release inside the button, Enter or Space. A loading button does not activate.
Colour, fill, background and border transition over 80ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); a press is instant. The keybinding hint transitions over 80ms ease-in at rest and ease-out on hover and press.
Switching loading on or off must not move focus out of the button.

keyboard: Enter and Space activate it (Enter only for a link).
semantics: Disabled is announced; inactive and loading are aria-disabled but focusable.
While loading, the loadingAnnouncement is announced as a status and the button is described by it.
aria-expanded when it opens a menu.

notes.text: Default and danger read --button-default-shadow-resting, a 1px offset with no blur, not a soft shadow; it disappears when disabled or pressed (primary, danger) and on invisible.
Danger's disabled border reads --button-default-borderColor-disabled; there is no --button-danger-borderColor-disabled.
The 80ms transition and its curve are not tokens; the motion tokens' hover transition is 100ms.
Under forced colours focus draws a 1px transparent outline so the system ring shows.
LinkButton is Button rendered as an anchor; a native build navigates through the platform (or the app) and keeps Button's visuals.
